name: drag-import-relative-path
displayName: Drag And Drop Import Relative Path
description: Never type an import path again. Drag a file into the editor to generate a relative-path import for JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Angular, Vue, Svelte, Astro, MDX, CSS, SCSS, HTML, Markdown & LaTeX. 45 import styles, framework-aware placement, image/video/audio tags, LaTeX figures. Works with any bundler or runtime — Vite, webpack, Rollup, esbuild, Node.js, Deno, Bun.

configuration.title: Drag And Drop Import Relative Path

drag-import.preferences.importStatementP.title: Import statement placement
drag-import.preferences.importStatementP.description: Where to insert generated import statements in the destination file. Forced to 'Cursor' for HTML, Markdown, LaTeX, and when importing a non-stylesheet into a stylesheet. For .astro files, placement is constrained to the frontmatter block; for .vue and .svelte files, to the script block. Default: Bottom.
enumDescriptions: Insert before the first line of the file.
Append after the last recognised import / require / @import / @use line. Falls back to line 0 if no import is found.
Insert at the current cursor position.

drag-import.preferences.requestReview.title: Ask for a Marketplace review
drag-import.preferences.requestReview.description: Show a one-time notification asking for a Marketplace review after you have generated a number of imports. Never repeats once answered or dismissed. Turn this off to suppress it entirely.

drag-import.importStatement.script.prese.title: Preserve script file extension in imports
drag-import.importStatement.script.prese.description: Keep the source .js / .ts / .jsx / .tsx extension on the generated import path. Most module systems (Node, bundlers, TypeScript) omit it by convention, which is why this is off by default.

drag-import.importStatement.script.javas.title: JavaScript / JSX import style
drag-import.importStatement.script.javas.description: Template used for .js destinations, and for .js / .jsx sources imported into .jsx, .tsx, or .mdx files. '_relativePath_' is replaced with the computed relative path; 'name' becomes a snippet placeholder so your cursor lands on it after insertion.
enumDescriptions: ES module: namespace import (every export bound under one name)

drag-import.importStatement.script.types.title: TypeScript / TSX import style
drag-import.importStatement.script.types.description: Template used for .ts destinations, for .ts / .tsx sources imported into .tsx or .mdx files, and for all script sources imported into .vue, .svelte, or .astro files. '_relativePath_' is replaced with the computed relative path; 'name' becomes a snippet placeholder. With the 'import { name }' shape, Angular file conventions (.component, .directive, .pipe, .service, .module) auto-fill 'name' with a PascalCase identifier derived from the basename — for example, app-root.component.ts becomes { AppRootComponent }.
enumDescriptions: ES module: named import — legacy Angular files (.component / .directive / .pipe / .service / .module) auto-fill PascalCase identifiers (back-compat)
ES module: namespace import (every export bound under one name)
TypeScript: type-only import (TS 3.8+ — zero runtime, erased at compile time)
TypeScript: mixed value + type import (TS 4.5+ inline modifier)

drag-import.importStatement.styleSheet.p.title: Preserve stylesheet file extension in imports
drag-import.importStatement.styleSheet.p.description: Keep the source .css / .scss extension on the generated import path. Applies to .scss-into-.scss imports and to a .scss source imported inside a Vue / Svelte / Astro <style> block. Exception: .css extensions are always preserved inside .scss imports — Sass requires the extension to recognise a foreign-language import, and this setting has no effect there.

drag-import.importStatement.styleSheet.c.title: CSS @import style
drag-import.importStatement.styleSheet.c.description: Template used when a .css source is imported into a .css destination, or into a Vue / Svelte / Astro <style> block. '_relativePath_' is replaced with the computed relative path.

drag-import.importStatement.styleSheet.c.title: CSS image reference style
drag-import.importStatement.styleSheet.c.description: Snippet used when an image source is imported into a .css destination — typically for background-image, content, mask-image, and similar properties. '_relativePath_' is replaced with the computed relative path.

drag-import.importStatement.styleSheet.s.title: SCSS @import / @use style
drag-import.importStatement.styleSheet.s.description: Template used when a .scss or .css source is imported into a .scss destination, or into a Vue / Svelte / Astro <style> block. Modern Sass uses @use for a true module system; legacy Sass uses @import. Leading underscores on partial filenames (e.g. _variables.scss) are stripped automatically to match Sass's partial-resolution convention.
enumDescriptions: Modern @use with wildcard alias — no namespace prefix required

drag-import.importStatement.styleSheet.s.title: SCSS image reference style
drag-import.importStatement.styleSheet.s.description: Snippet used when an image source is imported into a .scss destination. Reuses the CSS image template — the url() syntax is identical between the two languages.

drag-import.importStatement.markup.htmlS.title: HTML <script> tag style
drag-import.importStatement.markup.htmlS.description: Tag inserted at the cursor when a .js source is imported into a .html destination. '_relativePath_' is replaced with the computed relative path.
enumDescriptions: Modern minimal — type is the HTML5 default
Deferred execution — runs after parsing, preserves order
ES module — native ESM in HTML
Async execution — order-independent, runs when downloaded

drag-import.importStatement.markup.htmlI.title: HTML tag style
drag-import.importStatement.markup.htmlI.description: Tag inserted at the cursor when an image source is imported into a .html destination. Choose between a basic tag, a lazy-loading variant, or an HTML embed with explicit dimensions. '_relativePath_' is replaced with the computed relative path.
enumDescriptions: Standard tag with placeholder alt text
Lazy loading — opt-in for below-fold images
Explicit dimensions — Core Web Vitals CLS prevention

drag-import.importStatement.markup.htmlV.title: HTML <video> tag style
drag-import.importStatement.markup.htmlV.description: Tag inserted at the cursor when a video source (.mp4, .webm, .mov) is imported into a .html destination. '_relativePath_' is replaced with the computed relative path.
enumDescriptions: Controls + poster — custom thumbnail before playback
Long-form video — preload metadata only (Core Web Vitals)

drag-import.importStatement.markup.htmlA.title: HTML <audio> tag style
drag-import.importStatement.markup.htmlA.description: Tag inserted at the cursor when an audio source (.mp3, .ogg, .wav, .m4a) is imported into a .html destination. '_relativePath_' is replaced with the computed relative path.

drag-import.importStatement.markup.htmlS.title: HTML <link> stylesheet style
drag-import.importStatement.markup.htmlS.description: Tag inserted at the cursor when a .css source is imported into a .html destination. '_relativePath_' is replaced with the computed relative path.

drag-import.importStatement.markup.markd.title: Markdown link style
drag-import.importStatement.markup.markd.description: Snippet inserted at the cursor when a .md source is imported into a .md destination. '_relativePath_' is replaced with the computed relative path; 'text' becomes a snippet placeholder for the link's display text.

drag-import.importStatement.markup.markd.title: Markdown image style
drag-import.importStatement.markup.markd.description: Snippet inserted at the cursor when an image source is imported into a .md destination. Choose between bare inline, inline with title, or an HTML embed. '_relativePath_' is replaced with the computed relative path.
enumDescriptions: Bare inline image — most common Markdown image form
Inline image syntax with hover-text title
HTML embed for sizing — Core Web Vitals CLS prevention

drag-import.importStatement.latex.preser.title: Preserve graphics file extension in LaTeX imports
drag-import.importStatement.latex.preser.description: Keep the source .pdf / .png / .jpg / .jpeg / .eps extension on the generated \includegraphics path. LaTeX can resolve an extensionless path against its configured graphics formats, but keeping the extension is unambiguous and matches the dropped file, so this is on by default.

drag-import.importStatement.latex.graphi.title: LaTeX graphics (figure) style
drag-import.importStatement.latex.graphi.description: Snippet inserted at the cursor when a graphic (.pdf, .png, .jpg, .jpeg, .eps) is imported into a .tex destination. '_relativePath_' is replaced with the computed relative path. The default figure float places \caption before \label so \ref resolves to the figure number.
enumDescriptions: Figure float — centered, sized, with caption and label
Sized graphic — width as a fraction of \textwidth, no float
Bare graphic — natural size, no float

drag-import.importStatement.latex.inputI.title: LaTeX \input / \include style
drag-import.importStatement.latex.inputI.description: Snippet inserted at the cursor when a .tex source is imported into a .tex destination. The .tex extension is omitted (LaTeX convention; \include requires it). '_relativePath_' is replaced with the computed relative path.

drag-import.importStatement.latex.biblio.title: LaTeX bibliography style
drag-import.importStatement.latex.biblio.description: Snippet inserted at the cursor when a .bib source is imported into a .tex destination. \addbibresource (biblatex) keeps the .bib extension; \bibliography (BibTeX) drops it. '_relativePath_' is replaced with the computed relative path.
